    69→const normalizeStatus = (status?: string): OrderStatus => {
    70→  const value = (status || '').toString().trim().toUpperCase()
    71→  if (Object.values(OrderStatus).includes(value as OrderStatus)) {
    72→    return value as OrderStatus
    73→  }
    74→  const legacyMap: Record<string, OrderStatus> = {
    75→    PENDING_ASSIGNMENT: OrderStatus.PENDING,
    76→    ASSIGNED: OrderStatus.PENDING_PICKUP,
    77→    CONFIRMED: OrderStatus.PENDING_PICKUP,
    78→    PICKED_UP: OrderStatus.PICKED_UP,
    79→    PICKING: OrderStatus.PICKED_UP,
    80→    IN_PROGRESS: OrderStatus.PICKED_UP,
    81→    ARRIVED: OrderStatus.PENDING_RECEIPT,
    82→    DELIVERED: OrderStatus.PENDING_RECEIPT,
    83→    RECEIVED: OrderStatus.PENDING_RECEIPT,
    84→    PENDING_SETTLEMENT: OrderStatus.PENDING_SETTLEMENT,
    85→    COMPLETED: OrderStatus.COMPLETED,
    86→    CANCELLED: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
    87→    REFUNDED: OrderStatus.REFUNDED
    88→  }
    89→  return legacyMap[value] || OrderStatus.PENDING
    90→}
    91→
    92→const normalizeOrderItem = (item: any) => ({
    93→  id: item.id?.toString(),
    94→  categoryId: item.categoryId ?? '',
    95→  categoryName: item.categoryName,
    96→  brandModel: item.brandModel,
    97→  condition: item.condition,
    98→  weight: item.weight ?? item.estimatedWeight ?? item.actualWeight,
    99→  quantity: item.quantity,
   100→  unitPrice: Number(item.unitPrice ?? 0),
   101→  amount: Number(item.amount ?? item.totalPrice ?? item.estimatedAmount ?? item.actualAmount ?? 0),
   102→  photos: Array.isArray(item.photos)
   103→    ? item.photos.map((p: string) => (p || '').trim().replace(/^`|`$/g, '')).filter(Boolean)
   104→    : [],
   105→  thumbnailUrls: Array.isArray(item.thumbnailUrls)
   106→    ? item.thumbnailUrls.map((p: string) => (p || '').trim().replace(/^`|`$/g, '')).filter(Boolean)
   107→    : [],
   108→  notes: item.notes,
   109→  createdAt: item.createdAt,
   110→})
   111→
   112→const normalizeOrder = (order: any) => {
   113→  const status = normalizeStatus(order.status)
   114→  const items = Array.isArray(order.items) ? order.items.map(normalizeOrderItem) : []
   115→  return {
   116→    id: (order.id ?? order.orderId ?? order.orderNo ?? '').toString(),
   117→    userId: order.userId?.toString() ?? '',
   118→    status,
   119→    statusText: getStatusText(status),
   120→    categoryName: order.categoryName ?? items[0]?.categoryName ?? '',
   121→    items,
   122→    estimatedWeight: order.estimatedWeight ?? 0,
   123→    estimatedPrice: Number(order.estimatedAmount ?? order.estimatedPrice ?? 0),
   124→    actualPrice: order.settlementAmount ?? order.actualPrice ?? order.actualAmount ? Number(order.settlementAmount ?? order.actualPrice ?? order.actualAmount) : null,
   125→    address: order.address ?? order.addressId ?? '',
   126→    appointmentTime: order.expectPickupTime ?? order.appointmentTime ?? '',
   127→    courierName: order.courierName,
   128→    courierPhone: order.courierPhone,
   129→    createTime: order.createdAt ?? order.createTime ?? '',
   130→    updateTime: order.updatedAt ?? order.updateTime ?? '',
   131→    timeSlot: order.timeSlot ?? {
   132→      id: '',
   133→      date: '',
   134→      startTime: '',
   135→      endTime: '',
   136→      capacity: 0,
   137→      booked: 0,
   138→      isAvailable: true,
   139→    },
   140→  } as Order
   141→}
   142→
   143→const PAGE_SIZE = 10
   144→
   145→const OrderListPage: React.FC = () => {
   146→  const { user } = useAuth();
   147→  const { handleRecycleClick } = useRecycleNavigation();
   148→  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   149→  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
   150→  const [orderList, setOrderList] = useState<Order[]>([]);
   151→  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'all' | OrderStatus>('all');
   152→  const [showCategorySelect, setShowCategorySelect] = useState(false);
   153→  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(PAGE_SIZE)
   154→
   155→  const loadOrderList = useCallback(async () => {
   156→    if (!user?.id) {
   157→      setOrderList([])
   158→      setLoading(false)
   159→      return
   160→    }
   161→    try {
   162→      setLoading(true);
   163→      const result = await getUserOrders(user.id);
   164→      if (!result?.data?.orders) {
   165→        console.warn('订单数据格式异常:', result);
   166→        setOrderList([]);
   167→        return;
   168→      }
   169→      const rawOrders = Array.isArray(result.data.orders) ? result.data.orders : []
   170→      setOrderList(rawOrders.map(normalizeOrder))
   171→    } catch (error) {
   172→      console.error('加载订单列表失败:', error);
   173→      setOrderList([]);
   174→      Taro.showToast({
   175→        title: '加载失败，请重试',
   176→        icon: 'error'
   177→      });
   178→    } finally {
   179→      setLoading(false);
   180→    }
   181→  }, [user?.id]);
   182→
   183→  // 监听用户登录状态变化，一旦获取到用户信息（登录成功），立即加载订单
   184→  useEffect(() => {
   185→    loadOrderList();
   186→  }, [loadOrderList]);
   187→
   188→  // 监听页面显示，检查是否有来自其他页面的跳转参数，并触发数据加载
   189→  Taro.useDidShow(() => {
   190→    const targetTab = Taro.getStorageSync('ORDER_ACTIVE_TAB')
   191→    if (targetTab) {
   192→      setActiveTab(targetTab as any)
   193→      Taro.removeStorageSync('ORDER_ACTIVE_TAB')
   194→    }
   195→    loadOrderList()
   196→  })
   197→
   198→  const handleRefresh = async () => {
   199→    setRefreshing(true);
   200→    await loadOrderList();
   201→    setRefreshing(false);
   202→  };
   203→
   204→
   205→
   206→  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
   207→    if (activeTab === 'all') return orderList
   208→    return orderList.filter(order => order.status === activeTab)
   209→  }, [orderList, activeTab])
   210→
   211→  useEffect(() => {
   212→    setVisibleCount(PAGE_SIZE)
   213→  }, [activeTab, orderList.length])
   214→
   215→  const handleLoadMore = useCallback(() => {
   216→    if (visibleCount < filteredOrders.length) {
   217→      setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + PAGE_SIZE, filteredOrders.length))
   218→    }
   219→  }, [visibleCount, filteredOrders.length])
   220→
   221→  const visibleOrders = useMemo(() => {
   222→    return filteredOrders.slice(0, visibleCount)
   223→  }, [filteredOrders, visibleCount])
   224→
   225→  const handleOrderClick = useCallback((orderId: string) => {
   226→    Taro.navigateTo({
   227→      url: `/pages/order/detail/index?id=${orderId}`
   228→    });
   229→  }, []);
   230→
   231→  const handleCreateOrder = useCallback(() => {
   232→    setShowCategorySelect(true);
   233→  }, []);
   234→
   235→  const handleCardClick = useCallback((type: 'book' | 'clothes') => {
   236→    setShowCategorySelect(false);
   237→    handleRecycleClick(type);
   238→  }, [handleRecycleClick]);
   239→
   240→  // Render order item component
   241→  const renderOrderItem = useCallback((order: Order) => (
   242→    <View
   243→      key={order.id}
   244→      className="order-card"
   245→      onClick={() => handleOrderClick(order.id)}
   246→      hoverClass="order-card-hover"
   247→      hoverStayTime={70}
   248→    >
   249→      <View className="card-header">
   250→        <Text className="order-no">订单号 {order.id}</Text>
   251→        <View
   252→          className={`status-tag ${order.status.toLowerCase()}`}
   253→          style={{
   254→            color: getStatusColor(order.status),
   255→            backgroundColor: `${getStatusColor(order.status)}15`
   256→          }}
   257→        >
   258→          <Text className="status-text">{getStatusText(order.status)}</Text>
   259→        </View>
   260→      </View>
   261→
   262→      <View className="card-body">
   263→        {Array.isArray(order.items) && order.items.map((item, index) => (
   264→          <View key={index} className="item-row">
   265→            <View className="item-image-placeholder">
   266→              {item.photos && item.photos.length > 0 ? (
   267→                <Image
   268→                  src={getCdnUrl(item.photos[0], { w: 160, h: 160, fmt: 'webp', q: 80 })}
   269→                  className="item-img"
   270→                  mode="aspectFill"
   271→                />
   272→              ) : (
   273→                <View className="icon-wrapper">
   274→                  {(item.categoryName || '').includes('书') ? <Icon name='book' size={24} color='#999' /> : <Icon name='clothes' size={24} color='#999' />}
   275→                </View>
   276→              )}
   277→            </View>
   278→            <View className="item-content">
   279→              <View className="item-main">
   280→                <Text className="item-title">{item.categoryName || '回收物品'}</Text>
   281→                <Text className="item-price">
   282→                  {item.amount ? `¥${item.amount.toFixed(2)}` : '待估价'}
   283→                </Text>
   284→              </View>
   285→              <View className="item-sub">
   286→                <Text className="item-specs">
   287→                  {(item.weight) ? `${item.weight}kg` : ''}
   288→                  {item.weight && item.unitPrice ? ' | ' : ''}
   289→                  {item.unitPrice ? `¥${item.unitPrice}/kg` : ''}
   290→                </Text>
   291→              </View>
   292→            </View>
   293→          </View>
   294→        ))}
   295→      </View>
   296→
   297→      <View className="card-footer">
   298→        <View className="info-col">
   299→          <Text className="info-text">{formatDate(order.appointmentTime || order.createTime)}</Text>
   300→        </View>
   301→        <View className="total-col">
   302→          <Text className="total-label">预估合计</Text>
   303→          <Text className="total-price">
   304→            <Text className="symbol">¥</Text>
   305→            {order.actualPrice ? order.actualPrice.toFixed(2) : (order.estimatedPrice?.toFixed(2) ?? '0.00')}
   306→          </Text>
   307→        </View>
   308→      </View>
   309→    </View>
   310→  ), [handleOrderClick]);
   311→
   312→  return (
   313→    <AuthGuard showLoginPrompt>
   314→      <View className="order-list-page">
   315→        {/* 状态筛选标签 - 悬浮胶囊风格 */}
   316→        <View className="tab-container">
   317→          <View className="tab-list">
   318→            {[
   319→              { key: 'all', label: '全部' },
   320→              { key: OrderStatus.PENDING, label: '待接单' },
   321→              { key: OrderStatus.PENDING_PICKUP, label: '待上门' },
   322→              { key: OrderStatus.COMPLETED, label: '已完成' }
   323→            ].map(tab => (
   324→              <View
   325→                key={tab.key}
   326→                className={`tab-item ${activeTab === tab.key ? 'active' : ''}`}
   327→                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key as any)}
   328→              >
   329→                <Text className="tab-text">{tab.label}</Text>
   330→                {activeTab === tab.key && <View className="active-indicator" />}
   331→              </View>
   332→            ))}
   333→          </View>
   334→        </View>
   335→
   336→        {/* 订单列表 */}
   337→        <ScrollView
   338→          className="content-container"
   339→          scrollY
   340→          refresherEnabled
   341→          refresherTriggered={refreshing}
   342→          onRefresherRefresh={handleRefresh}
   343→          onScrollToLower={handleLoadMore}
   344→          lowerThreshold={60}
   345→        >
   346→          {loading ? (
   347→            <View className="loading-container">
   348→              <Text className="loading-text">加载中...</Text>
   349→            </View>
   350→          ) : visibleOrders.length > 0 ? (
   351→            <View className="order-list">
   352→              {visibleOrders.map(order => renderOrderItem(order))}
   353→            </View>
   354→          ) : (
   355→            <View className="empty-container">
   356→              <Image
   357→                src={EmptyIcon}
   358→                className="empty-img"
   359→                mode="aspectFit"
   360→              />
   361→              <Text className="empty-title">暂无订单</Text>
   362→              <Text className="empty-desc">
   363→                {activeTab === 'all' ? '快去回收你的第一件物品吧' : '当前状态下没有订单哦'}
   364→              </Text>
   365→              <Button
   366→                className="create-order-btn"
   367→                onClick={handleCreateOrder}
   368→              >
   369→                立即下单
   370→              </Button>
   371→            </View>
   372→          )}
   373→        </ScrollView>
   374→
   375→        {/* 底部创建订单按钮 */}
   376→        {
   377→          filteredOrders.length > 0 && (
   378→            <View className="fab-container">
   379→              <Button
   380→                className="fab-btn"
   381→                onClick={handleCreateOrder}
   382→              >
   383→                +
   384→              </Button>
   385→            </View>
   386→          )
   387→        }
   388→
   389→        {/* 分类选择弹窗 */}
   390→        <Popup
   391→          visible={showCategorySelect}
   392→          position="bottom"
   393→          round
   394→          onClose={() => setShowCategorySelect(false)}
   395→          className="category-popup"
   396→        >
   397→          <View className="popup-header">
   398→            <Text className="popup-title">选择回收类型</Text>
   399→            <View className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowCategorySelect(false)}>
   400→              <Icon name="close" size={20} color="#999" />
   401→            </View>
   402→          </View>
   403→          <View className="category-options">
   404→            <RecycleCard
   405→              type='book'
   406→              onClick={() => handleCardClick('book')}
   407→              className='popup-action-card'
   408→            />
   409→            <RecycleCard
   410→              type='clothes'
   411→              onClick={() => handleCardClick('clothes')}
   412→              className='popup-action-card'
   413→            />
   414→          </View>
   415→        </Popup>
   416→      </View >
   417→    </AuthGuard >
   418→  );
   419→};
   420→
   421→export default OrderListPage;
   422→

    21→// 生成缓存键
    22→const generateCacheKey = (url: string, method: string, data?: any): string => {
    23→    const dataStr = data ? JSON.stringify(data) : '';
    24→    return `${method}:${url}:${dataStr}`;
    25→}
    26→
    27→// 简单的刷新逻辑（避免并发情况下重复刷新）
    28→let refreshing = false
    29→let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null
    30→
    31→export const attemptTokenRefresh = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
    32→    const refreshToken = Storage.getRefreshToken()
    33→    if (!refreshToken) return null
    34→
    35→    if (refreshing && refreshPromise) {
    36→        return refreshPromise
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    refreshing = true
    40→    refreshPromise = (async () => {
    41→        try {
    42→            const response = await Taro.request({
    43→                url: `${API_BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`,
    44→                method: 'POST',
    45→                header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    46→                data: { refreshToken }
    47→            })
    48→
    49→            if (response.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 300) {
    50→                const body = response.data || {}
    51→                const newToken = body.accessToken || body.token
    52→                if (newToken) {
    53→                    Storage.setToken(newToken)
    54→                    return newToken
    55→                }
    56→                return null
    57→            }
    58→            return null
    59→        } catch (e) {
    60→            return null
    61→        } finally {
    62→            refreshing = false
    63→            refreshPromise = null
    64→        }
    65→    })()
    66→
    67→    return refreshPromise
    68→}
    69→
    70→// 通用请求函数
    71→const request = async <T = any>(url: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> => {
    72→    const token = Storage.getToken()
    73→
    74→    const defaultOptions = {
    75→        timeout: options.timeout || 10000,
    76→        method: options.method || 'GET',
    77→        data: options.data,
    78→        header: {
    79→            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    80→            ...(token ? { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    81→            ...options.header
    82→        }
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    // Check cache for GET requests if caching is enabled
    86→    const shouldCache = options.cache !== false && defaultOptions.method === 'GET';
    87→    const cacheKey = generateCacheKey(url, defaultOptions.method, defaultOptions.data);
    88→
    89→    if (shouldCache) {
    90→        return requestCache.getOrFetch(
    91→            cacheKey,
    92→            async () => {
    93→                return executeRequest<T>(url, defaultOptions);
    94→            },
    95→            options.cacheTTL
    96→        );
    97→    }
    98→
    99→    return executeRequest<T>(url, defaultOptions);
   100→}
   101→
   102→// Execute actual HTTP request
   103→const executeRequest = async <T = any>(url: string, options: any): Promise<T> => {
   104→    const startTime = Date.now();
   105→
   106→    try {
   107→        // Check network status before making request
   108→        if (!networkStatusManager.isConnected()) {
   109→            throw errorHandler.handle(
   110→                { code: 'NETWORK_OFFLINE', message: '当前无网络连接' },
   111→                { showToast: true }
   112→            );
   113→        }
   114→
   115→        const fullUrl = `${API_BASE_URL}${url}`
   116→        console.log(`[API Request] ${options.method} ${fullUrl}`)
   117→
   118→        const response = await Taro.request({
   119→            url: fullUrl,
   120→            ...options
   121→        })
   122→
   123→        // Track API performance
   124→        performanceMonitor.trackAPIRequest(
   125→            url,
   126→            options.method,
   127→            startTime,
   128→            response.statusCode
   129→        );
   130→
   131→        console.log(`[API Response] ${response.statusCode} ${url}`)
   132→
   133→        if (response.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 300) {
   134→            const body = response.data as any
   135→            if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'success' in body) {
   136→                if (body.success === false) {
   137→                    const error = {
   138→                        statusCode: response.statusCode,
   139→                        data: response.data,
   140→                        code: body?.error?.code || body?.code,
   141→                        message: body?.error?.message || body?.message || '请求失败'
   142→                    }
   143→                    throw errorHandler.handle(error, { showToast: true })
   144→                }
   145→                return body as T
   146→            }
   147→            return response.data as T
   148→        } else if (response.statusCode === 401) {
   149→            const newToken = await attemptTokenRefresh()
   150→            if (newToken) {
   151→                const retryOptions = {
   152→                    ...options,
   153→                    header: {
   154→                        ...options.header,
   155→                        Authorization: `Bearer ${newToken}`
   156→                    }
   157→                }
   158→                const retryResp = await Taro.request({ url: fullUrl, ...retryOptions })
   159→                if (retryResp.statusCode >= 200 && retryResp.statusCode < 300) {
   160→                    const retryBody = retryResp.data as any
   161→                    if (retryBody && typeof retryBody === 'object' && 'success' in retryBody) {
   162→                        if (retryBody.success === false) {
   163→                            const error = {
   164→                                statusCode: retryResp.statusCode,
   165→                                data: retryResp.data,
   166→                                code: retryBody?.error?.code || retryBody?.code,
   167→                                message: retryBody?.error?.message || retryBody?.message || '请求失败'
   168→                            }
   169→                            throw errorHandler.handle(error, { showToast: true })
   170→                        }
   171→                        return retryBody as T
   172→                    }
   173→                    return retryResp.data as T
   174→                }
   175→            }
   176→            const body = response.data as any
   177→            const error = {
   178→                statusCode: response.statusCode,
   179→                data: response.data,
   180→                code: body?.error?.code || body?.code || 'UNAUTHORIZED',
   181→                message: body?.error?.message || body?.message || '未授权或会话已过期'
   182→            }
   183→            throw errorHandler.handle(error, { showToast: true })
   184→        } else {
   185→            const body = response.data as any
   186→            const error = {
   187→                statusCode: response.statusCode,
   188→                data: response.data,
   189→                code: body?.error?.code || body?.code,
   190→                message: body?.error?.message || body?.message || `Request failed with status ${response.statusCode}`
   191→            };
   192→            throw errorHandler.handle(error, { showToast: true });
   193→        }
   194→    } catch (error: unknown) {
   195→        // Track failed request
   196→        performanceMonitor.trackAPIRequest(
   197→            url,
   198→            options.method,
   199→            startTime,
   200→            0
   201→        );
   202→
   203→        // Handle error with error handler
   204→        if (typeof error === 'object' && error !== null) {
   205→            const maybeHandled = error as { code?: unknown; timestamp?: unknown }
   206→            if (maybeHandled.code && maybeHandled.timestamp) {
   207→                throw error
   208→            }
   209→        }
   210→
   211→        throw errorHandler.handle(error, { showToast: true })
   212→    }
   213→}
   214→
   215→// 封装各种HTTP方法
   216→export function get<T = any>(url: string, params?: any, options?: { cache?: boolean; cacheTTL?: number }) {
   217→    return request<T>(url, { method: 'GET', data: params, ...options })
   218→}
   219→
   220→export function post<T = any>(url: string, data?: any) {
   221→    return request<T>(url, { method: 'POST', data })
   222→}
   223→
   224→export function put<T = any>(url: string, data?: any) {
   225→    return request<T>(url, { method: 'PUT', data })
   226→}
   227→
   228→export function del<T = any>(url: string) {
   229→    return request<T>(url, { method: 'DELETE' })
   230→}
   231→
   232→// 清除缓存工具函数
   233→export const clearCache = (pattern?: string | RegExp) => {
   234→    if (pattern) {
   235→        requestCache.invalidatePattern(pattern);
   236→    } else {
   237→        requestCache.clear();
   238→    }
   239→}
   240→
   241→// 导出request函数供高级用法
   242→export { request }
   243→
   244→// 文件上传函数
   245→export const upload = async <T = any>(
   246→    url: string,
   247→    filePath: string,
   248→    formData?: Record<string, string>,
   249→    header?: Record<string, string>
   250→): Promise<T & { success: boolean; url?: string; message?: string }> => {
   251→    const token = Storage.getToken()
   252→    const fullUrl = `${API_BASE_URL}${url}`
   253→
   254→    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   255→        Taro.uploadFile({
   256→            url: fullUrl,
   257→            filePath,
   258→            name: 'file',
   259→            formData,
   260→            header: {
   261→                'Authorization': token ? `Bearer ${token}` : '',
   262→                ...header
   263→            },
   264→            success: (res) => {
   265→                if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
   266→                    try {
   267→                        const data = JSON.parse(res.data)
   268→                        resolve(data)
   269→                    } catch {
   270→                        resolve({
   271→                            success: true,
   272→                            url: res.data,
   273→                            message: '上传成功'
   274→                        } as any)
   275→                    }
   276→                } else {
   277→                    reject(new Error(`上传失败: ${res.statusCode}`))
   278→                }
   279→            },
   280→            fail: (err) => {
   281→                reject(new Error(err.errMsg || '上传失败'))
   282→            }
   283→        })
   284→    })
   285→}
   286→
```

// 积分商城相关类型定义

// ==================== 枚举类型 ====================

/** 商品类型 */
export enum ProductType {
  VIRTUAL = 'VIRTUAL',   // 虚拟商品
  PHYSICAL = 'PHYSICAL', // 实物商品
}

/** 商品状态 */
export enum ProductStatus {
  ACTIVE = 'ACTIVE',     // 上架
  INACTIVE = 'INACTIVE', // 下架
}

/** 积分订单状态 */
export enum PointsOrderStatus {
  PENDING = 'PENDING',       // 待处理
  SHIPPED = 'SHIPPED',       // 已发货
  COMPLETED = 'COMPLETED',   // 已完成
  CANCELLED = 'CANCELLED',   // 已取消
}

/** 积分类型 */
export enum PointsType {
  ORDER_REWARD = 'ORDER_REWARD', // 订单奖励
  SIGN_IN = 'SIGN_IN',          // 签到
  INVITE = 'INVITE',            // 邀请好友
  TASK = 'TASK',                // 任务奖励
  EXCHANGE = 'EXCHANGE',        // 兑换消费
  ADJUST = 'ADJUST',            // 管理员调整
  REFUND = 'REFUND',            // 退款返还
}

/** 任务类型 */
export enum TaskType {
  PROFILE_COMPLETE = 'PROFILE_COMPLETE', // 完善资料
  FIRST_ORDER = 'FIRST_ORDER',          // 首单
  REVIEW = 'REVIEW',                    // 评价
  SHARE = 'SHARE',                      // 分享
  CUSTOM = 'CUSTOM',                    // 自定义
}

// ==================== 商品相关 ====================

/** 积分商品 */
export interface PointsProduct {
  id: string
  name: string
  description?: string
  coverImage?: string
  images: string[]
  type: ProductType
  points: number
  stock: number
  soldCount: number
  status: ProductStatus
  sortOrder: number
  categoryId?: number
  extraData?: Record<string, any>
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

/** 积分商品分类 */
export interface PointsProductCategory {
  id: number
  name: string
  icon?: string
  sortOrder: number
  isActive: boolean
}

// ==================== 订单相关 ====================

/** 积分兑换订单 */
export interface PointsOrder {
  id: string
  orderNo: string
  userId: string
  productId: string
  productName: string
  productImage?: string
  productType: ProductType
  points: number
  quantity: number
  status: PointsOrderStatus
  addressId?: string
  addressSnapshot?: OrderAddressSnapshot
  logisticsNo?: string
  logisticsCompany?: string
  remark?: string
  shippedAt?: string
  completedAt?: string
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
  product?: PointsProduct
}

/** 订单地址快照 */
export interface OrderAddressSnapshot {
  name: string
  mobile: string
  province?: string
  city?: string
  district?: string
  detail: string
}

// ==================== 积分记录 ====================

/** 积分记录 */
export interface PointsRecord {
  id: string
  userId: string
  type: PointsType
  points: number // 正数为获取，负数为消费
  balanceAfter: number
  sourceType?: string
  sourceId?: string
  description: string
  operatorId?: string
  createdAt: string
}

/** 积分记录统计 */
export interface PointsRecordStats {
  totalEarned: number
  totalSpent: number
  totalCount: number
}

// ==================== 签到相关 ====================

/** 签到状态 */
export interface SignInStatus {
  isSignedInToday: boolean
  continuousDays: number
  todayPoints: number
  nextBonusDays: number
  nextBonusPoints: number
}

/** 签到记录 */
export interface SignInRecord {
  id: string
  userId: string
  signInDate: string
  continuousDays: number
  points: number
  createdAt: string
}

// ==================== 任务相关 ====================

/** 积分任务 */
export interface PointsTask {
  id: string
  name: string
  description?: string
  type: TaskType
  points: number
  icon?: string
  config?: Record<string, any>
  isActive: boolean
  sortOrder: number
  isCompleted?: boolean
}

// ==================== 邀请相关 ====================

/** 邀请统计 */
export interface InviteStats {
  totalInvites: number
  validInvites: number
  totalRewardPoints: number
  inviteCode: string
}

/** 邀请记录 */
export interface InviteRecord {
  id: string
  inviterId: string
  inviteeId: string
  rewardPoints: number
  createdAt: string
  invitee?: {
    id: string
    nickname?: string
    avatarUrl?: string
    mobile?: string
  }
}

// ==================== 概览 ====================

/** 积分概览 */
export interface PointsOverview {
  points: number           // 当前积分
  totalEarned: number      // 累计获得
  totalSpent: number       // 累计消费
  continuousDays: number   // 连续签到天数
  pendingOrders: number    // 待处理订单数
}

// ==================== API 请求参数 ====================

/** 创建兑换订单请求 */
export interface CreatePointsOrderRequest {
  productId: string
  quantity?: number
  addressId?: string
  remark?: string
}

/** 查询商品列表参数 */
export interface QueryProductsParams {
  page?: number
  limit?: number
  status?: ProductStatus
  type?: ProductType
  categoryId?: number
}

/** 查询订单列表参数 */
export interface QueryPointsOrdersParams {
  page?: number
  limit?: number
  status?: PointsOrderStatus
}

// ==================== API 响应 ====================

/** 分页响应 */
export interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  data: T[]
  total: number
  page: number
  limit: number
  totalPages: number
}

```

```typescript
import { get, post } from '@/utils/request'
import {
  PointsOverview,
  PointsProduct,
  PointsProductCategory,
  PointsOrder,
  PointsRecord,
  PointsRecordStats,
  SignInStatus,
  SignInRecord,
  PointsTask,
  InviteStats,
  InviteRecord,
  CreatePointsOrderRequest,
  QueryProductsParams,
  QueryPointsOrdersParams,
  PaginatedResponse,
  PointsType,
} from '@/types/points-mall'

// ==================== 积分概览 ====================

/**
 * 获取积分概览
 */
export const getPointsOverview = () => {
  return get<PointsOverview>('/points/overview')
}

// ==================== 商品相关 ====================

/**
 * 获取商品列表
 */
export const getPointsProducts = (params?: QueryProductsParams) => {
  return get<PaginatedResponse<PointsProduct>>('/points/products', params)
}

/**
 * 获取商品分类
 */
export const getPointsProductCategories = () => {
  return get<PointsProductCategory[]>('/points/products/categories')
}

/**
 * 获取商品详情
 */
export const getPointsProduct = (id: string) => {
  return get<PointsProduct>(`/points/products/${id}`)
}

// ==================== 订单相关 ====================

/**
 * 创建兑换订单
 */
export const createPointsOrder = (data: CreatePointsOrderRequest) => {
  return post<PointsOrder>('/points/orders', data)
}

/**
 * 获取我的兑换订单列表
 */
export const getPointsOrders = (params?: QueryPointsOrdersParams) => {
  return get<PaginatedResponse<PointsOrder>>('/points/orders', params)
}

/**
 * 获取兑换订单详情
 */
export const getPointsOrder = (id: string) => {
  return get<PointsOrder>(`/points/orders/${id}`)
}

/**
 * 取消兑换订单
 */
export const cancelPointsOrder = (id: string) => {
  return post<PointsOrder>(`/points/orders/${id}/cancel`)
}

/**
 * 确认收货
 */
export const confirmPointsOrder = (id: string) => {
  return post<PointsOrder>(`/points/orders/${id}/confirm`)
}

// ==================== 积分记录 ====================

/**
 * 获取积分记录
 */
export const getPointsRecords = (params?: {
  page?: number
  limit?: number
  type?: PointsType
}) => {
  return get<PaginatedResponse<PointsRecord>>('/points/records', params)
}

/**
 * 获取积分记录统计
 */
export const getPointsRecordStats = () => {
  return get<PointsRecordStats>('/points/records/stats')
}

// ==================== 签到 ====================

/**
 * 签到
 */
export const signIn = () => {
  return post<SignInRecord>('/points/sign-in')
}

/**
 * 获取签到状态
 */
export const getSignInStatus = () => {
  return get<SignInStatus>('/points/sign-in/status')
}

/**
 * 获取签到记录
 */
export const getSignInRecords = (params?: { year?: number; month?: number }) => {
  return get<SignInRecord[]>('/points/sign-in/records', params)
}

// ==================== 任务 ====================

/**
 * 获取任务列表
 */
export const getPointsTasks = () => {
  return get<PointsTask[]>('/points/tasks')
}

/**
 * 完成任务
 */
export const completeTask = (id: string) => {
  return post<PointsTask>(`/points/tasks/${id}/complete`)
}

// ==================== 邀请 ====================

/**
 * 获取邀请统计
 */
export const getInviteStats = () => {
  return get<InviteStats>('/points/invite/stats')
}

/**
 * 获取邀请列表
 */
export const getInviteList = (params?: { page?: number; limit?: number }) => {
  return get<PaginatedResponse<InviteRecord>>('/points/invite/list', params)
}

```

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
import Taro, { usePullDownRefresh } from '@tarojs/taro'
import { View, Text, Image, ScrollView } from '@tarojs/components'
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth'
import AuthGuard from '@/components/AuthGuard'
import Icon from '@/components/Icon'
import {
  getPointsOverview,
  getPointsProducts,
  getPointsProductCategories,
  getSignInStatus,
  signIn,
} from '@/services/points-mall'
import {
  PointsOverview,
  PointsProduct,
  PointsProductCategory,
  SignInStatus,
  ProductType,
} from '@/types/points-mall'
import { getCdnUrl } from '@/utils/cdn'
import './index.scss'

const PAGE_SIZE = 20

const PointsMallPage: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<PointsOverview | null>(null)
  const [signInStatus, setSignInStatus] = useState<SignInStatus | null>(null)
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState<PointsProductCategory[]>([])
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<PointsProduct[]>([])
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true)
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false)

  const loadData = useCallback(async (isRefresh = false) => {
    try {
      if (isRefresh) {
        setLoading(true)
        setPage(1)
      }

      const [overviewRes, signInRes, categoriesRes, productsRes] = await Promise.all([
        getPointsOverview(),
        getSignInStatus(),
        getPointsProductCategories(),
        getPointsProducts({ page: 1, limit: PAGE_SIZE }),
      ])

      setOverview(overviewRes)
      setSignInStatus(signInRes)
      setCategories(categoriesRes)
      setProducts(productsRes.data || [])
      setHasMore((productsRes.page || 1) < (productsRes.totalPages || 1))
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载积分商城数据失败:', error)
      Taro.showToast({ title: '加载失败', icon: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData()
  }, [loadData])

  usePullDownRefresh(async () => {
    await loadData(true)
    Taro.stopPullDownRefresh()
  })

  const loadMoreProducts = async () => {
    if (loadingMore || !hasMore) return

    try {
      setLoadingMore(true)
      const nextPage = page + 1
      const res = await getPointsProducts({
        page: nextPage,
        limit: PAGE_SIZE,
        categoryId: activeCategory || undefined,
      })

      setProducts(prev => [...prev, ...(res.data || [])])
      setPage(nextPage)
      setHasMore((res.page || nextPage) < (res.totalPages || 1))
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载更多商品失败:', error)
    } finally {
      setLoadingMore(false)
    }
  }

  const handleCategoryChange = async (categoryId: number | null) => {
    setActiveCategory(categoryId)
    setPage(1)

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      const res = await getPointsProducts({
        page: 1,
        limit: PAGE_SIZE,
        categoryId: categoryId || undefined,
      })
      setProducts(res.data || [])
      setHasMore((res.page || 1) < (res.totalPages || 1))
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载分类商品失败:', error)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSignIn = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await signIn()
      Taro.showToast({
        title: `签到成功 +${result.points}积分`,
        icon: 'success',
      })
      // 刷新数据
      loadData(true)
    } catch (error: any) {
      Taro.showToast({
        title: error?.message || '签到失败',
        icon: 'error',
      })
    }
  }

  const handleProductClick = (product: PointsProduct) => {
    Taro.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/points-mall/detail/index?id=${product.id}`,
    })
  }

  const handleViewOrders = () => {
    Taro.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/points-mall/orders/index',
    })
  }

  const handleViewRecords = () => {
    Taro.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/points-mall/records/index',
    })
  }

  const renderProductItem = (product: PointsProduct) => (
    <View
      key={product.id}
      className="product-card"
      onClick={() => handleProductClick(product)}
      hoverClass="product-card-hover"
      hoverStayTime={100}
    >
      <View className="product-image-wrap">
        {product.coverImage ? (
          <Image
            className="product-image"
            src={getCdnUrl(product.coverImage, { w: 300, h: 300, fmt: 'webp', q: 80 })}
            mode="aspectFill"
          />
        ) : (
          <View className="product-image-placeholder">
            <Icon name="gift" size={48} color="#ccc" />
          </View>
        )}
        {product.type === ProductType.VIRTUAL && (
          <View className="virtual-tag">虚拟</View>
        )}
        {product.stock <= 0 && (
          <View className="sold-out-mask">已兑完</View>
        )}
      </View>
      <View className="product-info">
        <Text className="product-name">{product.name}</Text>
        <View className="product-bottom">
          <View className="points-wrap">
            <Icon name="star-fill" size={16} color="#FF9500" />
            <Text className="points-value">{product.points}</Text>
          </View>
          <Text className="sold-count">已兑{product.soldCount}件</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  )

  return (
    <AuthGuard showLoginPrompt>
      <View className="points-mall-page">
        {/* 顶部背景 */}
        <View className="header-bg" />

        {/* 积分概览卡片 */}
        <View className="overview-section">
          <View className="overview-card">
            <View className="points-main">
              <Text className="points-label">我的积分</Text>
              <Text className="points-value">{overview?.points || 0}</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="overview-stats">
              <View className="stat-item">
                <Text className="stat-value">{overview?.totalEarned || 0}</Text>
                <Text className="stat-label">累计获得</Text>
              </View>
              <View className="stat-divider" />
              <View className="stat-item">
                <Text className="stat-value">{overview?.totalSpent || 0}</Text>
                <Text className="stat-label">累计消费</Text>
              </View>
              <View className="stat-divider" />
              <View className="stat-item">
                <Text className="stat-value">{overview?.continuousDays || 0}</Text>
                <Text className="stat-label">连续签到</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* 快捷操作 */}
          <View className="quick-actions">
            <View
              className={`action-item ${signInStatus?.isSignedInToday ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
              onClick={signInStatus?.isSignedInToday ? undefined : handleSignIn}
            >
              <View className="action-icon sign-in">
                <Icon name="calendar-check" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text className="action-text">
                {signInStatus?.isSignedInToday ? '已签到' : '签到'}
              </Text>
              {signInStatus?.continuousDays && signInStatus.continuousDays > 0 && (
                <Text className="action-badge">{signInStatus.continuousDays}天</Text>
              )}
            </View>
            <View className="action-item" onClick={handleViewOrders}>
              <View className="action-icon orders">
                <Icon name="order" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text className="action-text">我的订单</Text>
              {overview?.pendingOrders && overview.pendingOrders > 0 && (
                <Text className="action-badge red">{overview.pendingOrders}</Text>
              )}
            </View>
            <View className="action-item" onClick={handleViewRecords}>
              <View className="action-icon records">
                <Icon name="list" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text className="action-text">积分明细</Text>
            </View>
            <View
              className="action-item"
              onClick={() => Taro.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/points-mall/tasks/index' })}
            >
              <View className="action-icon tasks">
                <Icon name="task" size={24} color="#fff" />
              </View>
              <Text className="action-text">赚积分</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 分类筛选 */}
        {categories.length > 0 && (
          <ScrollView className="category-scroll" scrollX showScrollbar={false}>
            <View className="category-list">
              <View
                className={`category-item ${activeCategory === null ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handleCategoryChange(null)}
              >
                <Text className="category-text">全部</Text>
              </View>
              {categories.map(cat => (
                <View
                  key={cat.id}
                  className={`category-item ${activeCategory === cat.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleCategoryChange(cat.id)}
                >
                  <Text className="category-text">{cat.name}</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          </ScrollView>
        )}

        {/* 商品列表 */}
        <ScrollView
          className="products-container"
          scrollY
          onScrollToLower={loadMoreProducts}
          lowerThreshold={100}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <View className="loading-wrap">
              <Text className="loading-text">加载中...</Text>
            </View>
          ) : products.length > 0 ? (
            <View className="products-grid">
              {products.map(renderProductItem)}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View className="empty-wrap">
              <Icon name="inbox" size={64} color="#ccc" />
              <Text className="empty-text">暂无商品</Text>
            </View>
          )}

          {loadingMore && (
            <View className="loading-more">
              <Text className="loading-more-text">加载更多...</Text>
            </View>
          )}

          {!hasMore && products.length > 0 && (
            <View className="no-more">
              <Text className="no-more-text">没有更多了</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </AuthGuard>
  )
}

export default PointsMallPage

@use '../../styles/global.scss' as *;

.points-mall-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background-color: $bg-color;
  padding-bottom: calc(constant(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 20rpx);
  padding-bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 20rpx);

  // 顶部渐变背景
  .header-bg {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 400rpx;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFF8E1 0%, #FFECB3 50%, $bg-color 100%);
    z-index: 0;
  }

  // 积分概览区域
  .overview-section {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    padding: $page-margin-top;
    padding-top: calc(constant(safe-area-inset-top) + #{$page-margin-top});
    padding-top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + #{$page-margin-top});

    .overview-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF9500 0%, #FF6B00 100%);
      border-radius: 32rpx;
      padding: 32rpx;
      margin-bottom: 24rpx;
      box-shadow: 0 8rpx 32rpx rgba(255, 149, 0, 0.3);

      .points-main {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 24rpx;

        .points-label {
          font-size: 28rpx;
          color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
          display: block;
          margin-bottom: 8rpx;
        }

        .points-value {
          font-size: 72rpx;
          font-weight: 800;
          color: #fff;
          font-family: $font-family-number;
        }
      }

      .overview-stats {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-around;
        padding-top: 24rpx;
        border-top: 1rpx solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);

        .stat-item {
          text-align: center;
          flex: 1;

          .stat-value {
            font-size: 36rpx;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            display: block;
            font-family: $font-family-number;
          }

          .stat-label {
            font-size: 22rpx;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            margin-top: 4rpx;
            display: block;
          }
        }

        .stat-divider {
          width: 1rpx;
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
          margin: 0 16rpx;
        }
      }
    }

    // 快捷操作
    .quick-actions {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 24rpx;
      padding: 24rpx 16rpx;
      box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);

      .action-item {
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        position: relative;

        &.disabled {
          opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .action-icon {
          width: 72rpx;
          height: 72rpx;
          border-radius: 20rpx;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          margin-bottom: 8rpx;

          &.sign-in {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF9500 0%, #FF6B00 100%);
          }

          &.orders {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5856D6 0%, #8A78C6 100%);
          }

          &.records {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #34C759 0%, #5FB57A 100%);
          }

          &.tasks {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #007AFF 0%, #5AC8FA 100%);
          }
        }

        .action-text {
          font-size: 24rpx;
          color: $text-color;
          font-weight: 500;
        }

        .action-badge {
          position: absolute;
          top: -4rpx;
          right: 20%;
          min-width: 32rpx;
          height: 32rpx;
          line-height: 32rpx;
          padding: 0 8rpx;
          background: #FF9500;
          color: #fff;
          font-size: 20rpx;
          font-weight: 600;
          border-radius: 16rpx;
          text-align: center;

          &.red {
            background: #FF3B30;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 分类筛选
  .category-scroll {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 16rpx 0;
    margin: 0 $spacing-base;

    .category-list {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 16rpx;

      .category-item {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 12rpx 32rpx;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 24rpx;
        font-size: 26rpx;
        color: $text-secondary;
        border: 1rpx solid #eee;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;

        &.active {
          background: $primary-color;
          color: #fff;
          border-color: $primary-color;
        }

        .category-text {
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 商品列表
  .products-container {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    height: calc(100vh - 500rpx - constant(safe-area-inset-top) - constant(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    height: calc(100vh - 500rpx - env(safe-area-inset-top) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    padding: 0 $spacing-base;

    .products-grid {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 20rpx;
      padding-bottom: 40rpx;

      .product-card {
        width: calc(50% - 10rpx);
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 24rpx;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 4rpx 16rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        transition: all 0.2s ease;

        &.product-card-hover {
          transform: translateY(-4rpx);
          box-shadow: 0 8rpx 24rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }

        .product-image-wrap {
          position: relative;
          width: 100%;
          height: 280rpx;

          .product-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
          }

          .product-image-placeholder {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #f5f5f5;
          }

          .virtual-tag {
            position: absolute;
            top: 12rpx;
            left: 12rpx;
            padding: 4rpx 12rpx;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #007AFF 0%, #5AC8FA 100%);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 20rpx;
            font-weight: 500;
            border-radius: 8rpx;
          }

          .sold-out-mask {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 28rpx;
            font-weight: 600;
          }
        }

        .product-info {
          padding: 16rpx;

          .product-name {
            font-size: 26rpx;
            color: $text-color;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
            line-height: 1.4;
            height: 72rpx;
          }

          .product-bottom {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 12rpx;

            .points-wrap {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;

              .points-value {
                font-size: 32rpx;
                font-weight: 700;
                color: #FF9500;
                margin-left: 4rpx;
                font-family: $font-family-number;
              }
            }

            .sold-count {
              font-size: 22rpx;
              color: $text-tertiary;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 加载状态
  .loading-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 80rpx 0;

    .loading-text {
      font-size: 26rpx;
      color: $text-tertiary;
    }
  }

  .loading-more {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 32rpx 0;

    .loading-more-text {
      font-size: 24rpx;
      color: $text-tertiary;
    }
  }

  // 空状态
  .empty-wrap {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 120rpx 0;

    .empty-text {
      font-size: 28rpx;
      color: $text-tertiary;
      margin-top: 24rpx;
    }
  }

  // 没有更多
  .no-more {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 32rpx 0;

    .no-more-text {
      font-size: 24rpx;
      color: $text-tertiary;
    }
  }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
import Taro, { useRouter } from '@tarojs/taro'
import { View, Text, Image, ScrollView, Button, RichText } from '@tarojs/components'
import { Popup } from '@nutui/nutui-react-taro'
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth'
import AuthGuard from '@/components/AuthGuard'
import Icon from '@/components/Icon'
import {
  getPointsProduct,
  getPointsOverview,
  createPointsOrder,
} from '@/services/points-mall'
import { getAddresses } from '@/services/address'
import { PointsProduct, PointsOverview, ProductType, Address } from '@/types'
import { getCdnUrl } from '@/utils/cdn'
import './index.scss'

const PointsMallDetailPage: React.FC = () => {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [product, setProduct] = useState<PointsProduct | null>(null)
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<PointsOverview | null>(null)
  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState<Address[]>([])
  const [showExchangePopup, setShowExchangePopup] = useState(false)
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<Address | null>(null)
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)

  const productId = router.params.id || ''

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!productId) {
      Taro.showToast({ title: '商品不存在', icon: 'error' })
      return
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true)
      const [productRes, overviewRes, addressRes] = await Promise.all([
        getPointsProduct(productId),
        getPointsOverview(),
        getAddresses(),
      ])

      setProduct(productRes)
      setOverview(overviewRes)
      const addressList = (addressRes as any)?.data || addressRes || []
      setAddresses(Array.isArray(addressList) ? addressList : [])

      // 默认选择第一个地址
      if (Array.isArray(addressList) && addressList.length > 0) {
        const defaultAddr = addressList.find((a: Address) => a.isDefault) || addressList[0]
        setSelectedAddress(defaultAddr)
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载商品详情失败:', error)
      Taro.showToast({ title: '加载失败', icon: 'error' })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [productId])

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData()
  }, [loadData])

  const handleExchange = () => {
    if (!product) return

    if (product.stock <= 0) {
      Taro.showToast({ title: '商品已兑完', icon: 'error' })
      return
    }

    if ((overview?.points || 0) < product.points * quantity) {
      Taro.showToast({ title: '积分不足', icon: 'error' })
      return
    }

    // 实物商品需要选择地址
    if (product.type === ProductType.PHYSICAL) {
      if (addresses.length === 0) {
        Taro.showModal({
          title: '提示',
          content: '请先添加收货地址',
          confirmText: '去添加',
          success: (res) => {
            if (res.confirm) {
              Taro.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/address/form/index' })
            }
          },
        })
        return
      }
      setShowExchangePopup(true)
    } else {
      // 虚拟商品直接兑换
      doExchange()
    }
  }

  const doExchange = async () => {
    if (!product || submitting) return

    try {
      setSubmitting(true)
      await createPointsOrder({
        productId: product.id,
        quantity,
        addressId: selectedAddress?.id,
      })

      Taro.showToast({
        title: '兑换成功',
        icon: 'success',
      })

      setShowExchangePopup(false)

      // 跳转到订单列表
      setTimeout(() => {
        Taro.redirectTo({
          url: '/pages/points-mall/orders/index',
        })
      }, 1500)
    } catch (error: any) {
      Taro.showToast({
        title: error?.message || '兑换失败',
        icon: 'error',
      })
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSelectAddress = () => {
    Taro.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/address/select/index?from=points-mall',
    })
  }

  const handleQuantityChange = (delta: number) => {
    const newQty = quantity + delta
    if (newQty >= 1 && newQty <= (product?.stock || 1)) {
      setQuantity(newQty)
    }
  }

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View className="detail-page loading-state">
        <Text className="loading-text">加载中...</Text>
      </View>
    )
  }

  if (!product) {
    return (
      <View className="detail-page empty-state">
        <Icon name="inbox" size={64} color="#ccc" />
        <Text className="empty-text">商品不存在</Text>
      </View>
    )
  }

  const totalPoints = product.points * quantity
  const canExchange = product.stock > 0 && (overview?.points || 0) >= totalPoints

  return (
    <AuthGuard showLoginPrompt>
      <View className="detail-page">
        <ScrollView className="content-scroll" scrollY>
          {/* 商品图片 */}
          <View className="product-images">
            {product.coverImage ? (
              <Image
                className="main-image"
                src={getCdnUrl(product.coverImage, { w: 750, h: 750, fmt: 'webp', q: 90 })}
                mode="aspectFill"
              />
            ) : (
              <View className="image-placeholder">
                <Icon name="gift" size={80} color="#ccc" />
              </View>
            )}
            {product.type === ProductType.VIRTUAL && (
              <View className="type-tag virtual">虚拟商品</View>
            )}
            {product.type === ProductType.PHYSICAL && (
              <View className="type-tag physical">实物商品</View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* 商品信息 */}
          <View className="product-info">
            <View className="info-header">
              <View className="points-row">
                <Icon name="star-fill" size={24} color="#FF9500" />
                <Text className="points-value">{product.points}</Text>
                <Text className="points-unit">积分</Text>
              </View>
              <Text className="sold-text">已兑{product.soldCount}件</Text>
            </View>
            <Text className="product-name">{product.name}</Text>
            {product.description && (
              <Text className="product-desc">{product.description}</Text>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* 兑换说明 */}
          <View className="exchange-info">
            <View className="info-item">
              <Text className="info-label">库存</Text>
              <Text className="info-value">{product.stock}件</Text>
            </View>
            <View className="info-item">
              <Text className="info-label">我的积分</Text>
              <Text className="info-value highlight">{overview?.points || 0}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* 兑换须知 */}
          <View className="notice-section">
            <Text className="section-title">兑换须知</Text>
            <View className="notice-list">
              <Text className="notice-item">• 虚拟商品兑换后立即生效，不可退换</Text>
              <Text className="notice-item">• 实物商品将在兑换后3-5个工作日内发货</Text>
              <Text className="notice-item">• 如有疑问请联系客服</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>

        {/* 底部操作栏 */}
        <View className="bottom-bar">
          <View className="points-check">
            <Text className="check-label">我的积分:</Text>
            <Text className="check-value">{overview?.points || 0}</Text>
          </View>
          <Button
            className={`exchange-btn ${!canExchange ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
            disabled={!canExchange || submitting}
            onClick={handleExchange}
          >
            {product.stock <= 0 ? '已兑完' : '立即兑换'}
          </Button>
        </View>

        {/* 兑换弹窗 - 实物商品选择地址 */}
        <Popup
          visible={showExchangePopup}
          position="bottom"
          round
          onClose={() => setShowExchangePopup(false)}
          className="exchange-popup"
        >
          <View className="popup-content">
            <View className="popup-header">
              <Text className="popup-title">确认兑换</Text>
              <View className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowExchangePopup(false)}>
                <Icon name="close" size={20} color="#999" />
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* 商品预览 */}
            <View className="product-preview">
              <Image
                className="preview-image"
                src={getCdnUrl(product.coverImage || '', { w: 120, h: 120, fmt: 'webp', q: 80 })}
                mode="aspectFill"
              />
              <View className="preview-info">
                <Text className="preview-name">{product.name}</Text>
                <View className="preview-points">
                  <Icon name="star-fill" size={16} color="#FF9500" />
                  <Text className="preview-points-value">{product.points}积分</Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* 数量选择 */}
            <View className="quantity-section">
              <Text className="quantity-label">数量</Text>
              <View className="quantity-control">
                <View
                  className={`qty-btn ${quantity <= 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleQuantityChange(-1)}
                >
                  <Icon name="minus" size={16} color={quantity <= 1 ? '#ccc' : '#333'} />
                </View>
                <Text className="qty-value">{quantity}</Text>
                <View
                  className={`qty-btn ${quantity >= product.stock ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleQuantityChange(1)}
                >
                  <Icon name="plus" size={16} color={quantity >= product.stock ? '#ccc' : '#333'} />
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* 地址选择 */}
            <View className="address-section">
              <Text className="address-label">收货地址</Text>
              {selectedAddress ? (
                <View className="selected-address" onClick={handleSelectAddress}>
                  <View className="address-info">
                    <Text className="address-name">{selectedAddress.name}</Text>
                    <Text className="address-mobile">{selectedAddress.mobile}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <Text className="address-detail">
                    {selectedAddress.province}{selectedAddress.city}{selectedAddress.district}{selectedAddress.detail}
                  </Text>
                  <Icon name="right" size={16} color="#999" className="address-arrow" />
                </View>
              ) : (
                <View className="no-address" onClick={handleSelectAddress}>
                  <Icon name="plus" size={16} color="#999" />
                  <Text className="no-address-text">添加收货地址</Text>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* 总计 */}
            <View className="total-section">
              <Text className="total-label">合计</Text>
              <View className="total-points">
                <Icon name="star-fill" size={20} color="#FF9500" />
                <Text className="total-value">{totalPoints}</Text>
                <Text className="total-unit">积分</Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* 确认按钮 */}
            <Button
              className={`confirm-btn ${!canExchange ? 'disabled' : ''}`}
              disabled={!canExchange || submitting}
              onClick={doExchange}
            >
              {submitting ? '兑换中...' : '确认兑换'}
            </Button>
          </View>
        </Popup>
      </View>
    </AuthGuard>
  )
}

export default PointsMallDetailPage
